text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
My gifts for Nature-san are muscle pain 
relief cream and an energy drink. I call 
it—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's the "Special Hard Worker Care 
Birthday Present"!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"E-Effort!? ...No, no, no! I appreciate 
the compliment, but... I'm really just a 
plain, ordinary Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. Just yesterday, you kept 
doing running drills over and over, 
saying, 'Shall we do one more...?!'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I-I get it, I got it already! 
Please, spare me, that's enough!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...! I'm sorry, there are still more 
presents...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There's more?! —Wait, huh? Dashi and soy 
sauce... this nostalgic, homey aroma...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I tried making oden, 'ssu! I heard you 
especially like daikon radish, Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Woah! Thank you so much! Man, you really 
'get it' with this choice...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Putting a dab of mustard on the edge 
of the plate, then lightly dipping the 
daikon... Ah, it's the absolute best~

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Take your time eating, and let it 
heal your daily fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Quietly, yet burning with a fighting 
spirit hotter than anyone's, you keep 
giving it your all. ...So today, I really 
wanna give you the biggest "Great job" 
possible, ssut.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! Uuugh, aww, jeez... Th-Thank you 
very much...
